verdicts.reason: Single predicate ADD is fluent and verifiable. The source text ends with 'while keeping the lights' (incomplete phrase). The negative adds 'framing the border' as a prepositional phrase specifying the predicate relation of the lights. This is a single semantic constraint addition that is clearly false for all supplied positives—none show lights framing any border; they show lights embedded within or around garlands/flowers, not framing borders.

The substitution of 'mirror garland' to 'ribbon garland' is incompatible with rejection criteria. Image 1 (reference) shows a mirror frame with a mixed-flower garland. The negative text substitutes the object to 'ribbon garland'. However, a ribbon garland could be used to frame a mirror identically to how the floral garland does in the reference, making the new fact compatible with all positives. The constraint change cannot be reliably rejected as false.
